name: Fluorolite Plastics LLC
old_description: Fluorolite specializes in Fluorescent and LED light covers replacement,  mostly plastic light covers for lighting  fixtures but we also provide some glass light covers. We replace old yellowed, broken and missing diffuser for all kind of light fixtures including street light refractors, flat sheets, globes, parabolic louvers, plastic egg crates or any other ceiling light covers.
about:
Fluorolite Plastics LLC operates from Hudson, Massachusetts. The company is a woman-owned business that states it has been trusted for over 45 years, specializing in replacement light covers for fluorescent and LED fixtures.

The firm manufactures a wide range of plastic and glass light diffusers, including flat sheets, wrap-around lenses, tube guards, vapor-tight fixtures, parabolic louvers, and egg-crate panels. It offers acrylic sheets in clear, transparent, or solid colors and uses a laser cutter to produce custom sizes and shapes. For non-stock profiles, the shop custom molds and vacuum forms thousands of different replacement covers for both commercial and residential projects.

Fluorolite serves commercial contractors, municipal street-lighting departments, and residential customers. Examples cited include kitchen under-cabinet diffusers, decorative cloud panels, and street-light refractors. The company also supports large-scale commercial projects and provides free quotes via an online form or email.

The company emphasizes its long-standing service record, competitive pricing, and award-winning support team, highlighted by Best of Framingham awards in 2021 and 2022. Its differentiators include in-house custom molding, vacuum forming, and laser cutting, allowing rapid turnaround on bespoke parts.
